subject: VeloxBank: acceptance playbook, owners & data retention clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@veloxbank.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procure@veloxbank.com
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & acceptance playbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA questions

David — thanks for the demo last week. Velox is excited to evaluate Redwood for customer-facing transaction enrichment. Before we lock timelines with procurement, security has three blockers we need covered inside the MAP: 

1) SOC 2 evidence windows — security needs mapped artifacts (system descriptions, recent Type II report, control owners) and a target delivery date.
2) SIG/CAIQ completion — we typically expect a completed CAIQ plus any open items tracked with owners and due dates in the MAP.
3) DPA redlines and retention — our legal team needs to confirm retention windows for raw message logs (we prefer 90/180 days options) and any escrow/archival obligations.

Can you send a proposed acceptance playbook with owners and an estimated close cadence? Also please include any artifacts you can share now so our security team can triage.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Senior Information Security Manager
VeloxBank

--
Attachment stubs: SOC2-request-template.xlsx (attachment requested)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@veloxbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance playbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA questions

Elena — appreciate the clear list. I've put together a draft acceptance playbook and a proposed cadence below. Attached is a short MAP draft (Velox-MAP-draft-20280321.pdf) and an evidence index spreadsheet that maps our typical SOC 2 artifacts to Velox's asks. Summary: 

• Target close window: 6–8 weeks from kickoff (can compress to 4 weeks if Velox approves co-scheduled activity). Proposed milestone dates in the MAP: Kickoff (Mar 28), Evidence intake (Apr 5), SIG/CAIQ review (Apr 12), DPA signoff & final acceptance (Apr 25).

• SOC 2: we can share our most recent Type II report under NDA and provide a control-owner contact list. I'll flag which artifacts are typically shared vs. which require redaction.

• SIG/CAIQ: we'll complete the CAIQ and surface any gaps as open items with owners and due dates in the MAP.

• DPA & retention: our standard options are 90 / 180 / 365 day retention tiers for raw logs; we can commit contractually to the tier you prefer. For archiving/escrow, we can propose a 3-yr archival SLA if required. I attached an annotated DPA redline to speed legal review.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Kickoff call to align owners and lock the MAP on Tue, Mar 28 — can you confirm availability?
2) Elena/security to send prioritized evidence list (attach to the CAIQ or mark on the index).
3) Redwood to provide an NDA share link for Type II and the completed CAIQ within 5 business days of kickoff.

I'll also loop in our SRE and legal as needed. If Velox needs an acceleration plan (co-scheduled evidence intake + on-site walkthrough), we can propose that as an optional sprint.

David
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Cell: (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Velox-MAP-draft-20280321.pdf; SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx; DPA-redline-annotated.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@veloxbank.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance playbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA questions

Elena / team — quick operational notes from our side: 

• Evidence intake owner: Jonas Weber (Security Solutions). Jonas will be the point for SOC2 artifacts and can accept secure uploads to our evidence intake bucket.
• SIG/CAIQ owner: Marissa Cole — I'll lead the CAIQ completion and annotate any documented compensating controls.
• DPA/legal lead: David will shepherd the DPA redline; our legal can do a fast review if Velox indicates preferred retention tier.

On retention tiers: if Velox requests 90-day retention for raw message logs, we need to confirm whether that applies to KV cache snapshots and audit logs separately — our default is 90 days for user content debug logs, 180 days for low-level Kafka audit logs. If necessary we can propose policy carve-outs in the DPA.

We can also publish a short evidence intake checklist to the shared Drive folder by Friday so security can begin triage. Proposed kickoff stays Tue, Mar 28 10:00am PT. Elena — does that time work?

Marissa
VP, Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@veloxbank.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & acceptance playbook — SOC2/SIG/DPA questions

Thanks — Tue 10:00am PT works for our team. We prefer 90-day retention for customer-facing raw logs but will confirm whether audit logs need to be longer; procurement copied here will push DPA review forward once we get your annotated redline and the evidence index.

Action items through kickoff: 
• Redwood: upload Type II under NDA + completed CAIQ (Jonas / Marissa owners) — due Apr 5 in the MAP.
• Velox security: send prioritized artifact list (we'll use the attached SOC2-request-template.xlsx you requested).
• Legal/procurement: target DPA review window Mar 29–Apr 12. Procurement: procure@veloxbank.com, please confirm.

I'll join the kickoff with our security lead and counsel. See you Tue.

Elena
-- End of thread --
